questions.introductory_text:
Two parallel metal plates, each of area A, are separated by a small distance d, as shown in Fig. 1.1.

The plates are initially charged using a power supply.

The plates are then connected to an uncharged capacitor. The potential difference V across the capacitor is measured.

It is suggested that V is related to d by the relationship
W/V = 1 + Cd/KA
where C is the capacitance of the capacitor, and K and W are constants.

Plan a laboratory experiment to test the relationship between V and d.

Draw a diagram showing the arrangement of your equipment.

Explain how the results could be used to determine values for K and W.

In your plan you should include:
● the procedure to be followed
● the measurements to be taken
● the control of variables
● the analysis of the data
● any safety precautions to be taken.

parts.text: Plan a laboratory experiment to test the relationship between V and d. Draw a diagram showing the arrangement of your equipment. Explain how the results could be used to determine values for K and W.

questions.introductory_text:
A student investigates the relationship between the luminosity L of a star and its mass M for a set of stars known as main-sequence stars.

It is suggested that L and M are related by the equation
L = SZMn
where S is the luminosity of the Sun, and Z and n are constants.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: A graph is plotted of lg L on the y-axis against lg M on the x-axis. Determine expressions for the gradient and y-intercept.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Values of M and L are given in Table 2.1. Calculate and record values of lg (M/10^30 kg) and lg (L/10^28 W) in Table 2.1. Include the absolute uncertainties in lg (M/10^30 kg).

subparts.label: (i)
subparts.text: Plot a graph of lg (L/10^28 W) against lg (M/10^30 kg). Include error bars for lg (M/10^30 kg).

subparts.label: (ii)
subparts.text: Draw the straight line of best fit and a worst acceptable straight line on your graph. Label both lines.

subparts.label: (iii)
subparts.text: Determine the gradient of the line of best fit. Include the absolute uncertainty in your answer.

subparts.label: (iv)
subparts.text: Determine the y-intercept of the line of best fit. Include the absolute uncertainty in your answer.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: Using your answers to (a), (c)(iii) and (c)(iv), determine the values of n and Z. Include the absolute uncertainties in your values. You need not be concerned with units. Data: S = 3.85 × 10^26 W

parts.label: (e)
parts.text: Another main-sequence star has a mass of 3.0 × 10^30 kg. Determine the luminosity L of this star.
